sourceText.he: בֶּן שְׁמֹנֶה חַי. וְהָתַנְיָא: בֶּן שְׁמֹנֶה חַי יוֹכִיחַ, שֶׁאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁיֵּשׁ בְּמִינוֹ שְׁחִיטָה – אֵין שְׁחִיטָתוֹ מְטַהַרְתּוֹ.

positions.claim: An eight-month-old fetus born alive is not rendered pure by slaughter, because slaughter does not apply to its kind
An eight-month-old fetus born alive proves the point: even though slaughter applies to its kind, its slaughter does not render it pure
